snippet.title: B.A.L.L.O  (PC Game) Play through
snippet.description:
I've had this game on my hard drive since 2004.  Fun little game, wondering if there are any newer versions of this game out with more levels?  Think this is an early W.I.P. version of the game.  Would like to play more.

http://ftp.dti.ad.jp/pub/scene/parties/2004/assembly04/game/ballo.zip
 
Credits for the game are:
